title: proto-forge configuration (api-node template)
description: Merged over the built-in strict defaults and any ~/.config/proto-forge/config.json. Run `pnpm config:show` to see what is actually in force and where each value came from. Anything omitted keeps its strict default — this file only records deviations.

policy.description: Documentation of intent. Enforcement comes from gates[].mode and waivers[], not from this field.

gates.description: Per-gate settings. Tightening is always allowed. Relaxing a mandatory gate (the MANDATORY_GATES list in scripts/config.mjs — arch, contract, errors, migration, opid, docs, security, stub, consistency, snapshot, coverage, ignores, mutation, external, log, deps, env, deploy) below "error" additionally requires a live waivers[] entry — without one, config:check fails AND the gate runs at "error" regardless of what is written here.

environments.description: The single declaration of the delivery chain: local, dev, sit, uat, test, prod — an object with fixed keys so an override merges deep instead of replacing the chain. An environment exists by being declared here and nowhere else: values files, the DEPLOYMENT.md table and the CD plan are derived from this object, and env:verify fails when they disagree. The template ships with only dev enabled; enabling a later environment is a reviewed config diff, never a regeneration.

deployment.description: How the application ships. helm is the cluster path; compose is the single-host simple mode and config:check refuses it as soon as any environment past dev is enabled.

flavor.description: helm deploys deploy/chart per environment. compose runs deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml on one host — dev at most, never a chain.

imageRegistry.description: Registry the pipeline pushes to, e.g. ghcr.io/acme. Empty keeps images local. Per-environment pulls may override via environments.<env>.cluster.registry.

sign.description: Sign pushed images (cosign, keyless) and verify the signature before every deploy. Turning this off removes the proof that what runs is what CI built.

image.description: Scan the built image before it is pushed; findings at or above severityThreshold fail the pipeline.

severityThreshold.description: The lowest severity that fails the image scan. "high" (the default) fails HIGH and CRITICAL. Exceptions live in .trivyignore, each with a reason and an expiry — never here.

chartPath.description: Path to the chart, relative to the repository root.

keepHistory.description: helm --history-max: how many releases stay available to roll back to. A rollback needs a release to roll back to, so the floor is 2.

dryRun.description: true (default) writes payloads to .proto-forge/outbox/ and contacts nothing. Live writes happen via `pnpm sync:jira --commit`, or unattended via `pnpm sync:auto` when autoPropagate is on.

autoPropagate.description: Standing, reviewed consent for unattended live writes: `pnpm sync:auto` (run by the pipeline after each accepted ADR and at release) sends without a per-run --approve. Stands in for --approve ONLY — enabled, dryRun:false, the network allowlist and credentials are still required.

createFor.description: Which pipeline events produce a ticket payload.

tokenEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the API token. Never the token itself.

autoPropagate.description: Standing, reviewed consent for unattended live publishes via `pnpm sync:auto`. Stands in for --approve only; all other requirements remain.

requireApproval.description: Outward-facing effects an operator must confirm interactively, e.g. "jira.create", "confluence.publish".

protectedPaths.description: Glob patterns an agent hook refuses to edit — the byte-pinned platform kernel, the locks, the append-only prompt log.

freezeThresholds.description: Refuse edits that would lower a coverage threshold or a mutation floor. Overridable for one command with PROTO_FORGE_ALLOW_THRESHOLD_EDIT=1.

waivers.description: The only way to relax a mandatory gate. Each entry expires; after that the gate enforces again on its own.

reason.description: What the relaxation buys and why the risk is acceptable.

adr.description: Number of an ADR that exists in docs/adr/.

mode.description: error = fails the build. warn = prints findings and passes. off = does not enforce.

localEnv.description: The developer's own machine. Not part of the promotion chain, and not optional: config:check fails when local is disabled, because local is where the prototype actually runs.

url.description: Where the service answers locally, e.g. http://localhost:3000 (`pnpm dev` and the compose-built image alike).

remoteEnv.description: One remote environment in the chain. Enabling it is the whole act of creating it: env:verify then requires the matching deploy/chart/values/<env>.yaml and the DEPLOYMENT.md table row, and the CD plan picks it up — nothing else declares an environment anywhere.

enabled.description: Whether this environment exists. An enabled environment must name its cluster.namespace and cluster.type; a values file for a DISABLED environment fails env:verify as an orphan.

url.description: The externally reachable base URL, the smoke test's target. Empty is a config:check warning: an environment nobody can reach cannot prove a deploy landed.

type.description: What is on the other side. Drives the exposure cross-check (a Route is OpenShift-only), the login step in CD and the platform notes in DEPLOYMENT.md.

server.description: API server URL. config:check warns when its host is missing from guardrails.network.allowedHosts — operator deploys to it would be refused.

namespace.description: Namespace (OpenShift: project) the release lands in. Required as soon as the environment is enabled.

registry.description: Registry this cluster pulls from when it differs from deployment.imageRegistry (e.g. an ACR the AKS cluster is attached to).

approval.description: Whether a human stands before the deploy. "required" maps to a GitHub environment with required reviewers, and CD preflights that the protection actually exists rather than trusting the label. prod with "none" is a config:check error; uat/test with "none" is a warning.

autoDeploy.description: Standing, reviewed consent for an UNATTENDED operator deploy to this environment — the deploy analogue of integrations.*.autoPropagate. It stands in for the per-run --approve of an operator deploy and for nothing else: guardrails, cluster context and credentials are still checked, and CI promotion consent stays with the committed workflow plus GitHub environment reviewers.

auth.description: How a deploy authenticates. Every *Env field names an environment VARIABLE to read at deploy time — never the credential itself; config:check rejects anything that does not look like an env var name.

method.description: oidc = federated login (AKS via azure *Env names below). token = bearer token (OpenShift oc login). kubeconfig = a context from the file kubeconfigEnv points at.

tokenEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the bearer token. Never the token itself.

kubeconfigEnv.description: Name of the env var pointing at the kubeconfig file.

azureClientIdEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the Azure client id for OIDC login.

azureTenantIdEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the Azure tenant id.

azureSubscriptionIdEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the Azure subscription id.
